assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: It is oriented to architecture and spatial presentation rather than implementation of an interactive 3D product-asset web preview.
assessments.rationale: Architecture guidance includes spatial viewing and material presentation concepts, but does not provide the requested browser implementation, model controls, and responsive integration.
Babylon.js directly supports web 3D scenes, loading supplied models, camera angle inspection, materials and colour adjustment, responsive interactive rendering, and integration guidance.
assessments.source_anchor: # Babylon.js — Professional 3D Engine for the Web

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: It targets Unreal Engine rather than a browser-based web implementation and does not provide concise web integration guidance.
assessments.rationale: Unreal can implement 3D model inspection, materials, and presentation modes, but is not the requested interactive web preview technology.

PlayCanvas directly targets browser-based interactive 3D applications and provides WebGL/WebGPU rendering, entity-component structure, and integration suitable for model inspection and presentation mode.
